title: Etale at a prime iff flat and unramified at that prime (finitely presented)
statement: Let R\to S be a ring map making S a finitely presented R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], let q be a prime of S and p=q\cap R. The following are equivalent: (1) Algebra.IsEtaleAt R q, that is, the localization S_q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is formally etale over R; (2) there is g\in S\setminus q such that \operatorname{Spec}S_g\to\operatorname{Spec}R is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]; (3) S_q is flat over R_p [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and the localization (\Omega_{S/R})_q of the module of Kahler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is zero.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U6 (lemma-characterize-etale, line 39470) with lemma-unramified-at-prime and Tag 08WD (lemma-etale-flat-unramified-finite-presentation, line 41644): pointwise characterization of etale at a prime

proof.text: For (1) iff (2), apply Mathlib Algebra.exists_etale_of_isEtaleAt in the forward direction. In the reverse direction, Algebra.basicOpen_subset_etaleLocus_iff_etale identifies etaleness of S_g with containment of D(g) in the etale locus; q belongs to D(g) since g is outside q. These are direct Mathlib statements, so no passage through naive cotangent vanishing or affine scheme morphisms is needed.

source.place: Tags 00U6 and 08WD; localization of differentials and flatness

proof.text: For (1) implies (3), choose an etale basic neighbourhood S_g by the first step. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-flat], S_g is flat over R. Give S_q its canonical S_g-algebra structure using powers(g) <= q.primeCompl. The localization-of-localization theorem identifies S_q as a localization of S_g, so it is flat over S_g and hence over R. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-over-localization] to R -> R_p to obtain flatness over R_p, with the algebra structure defined by Localization.localRingHom. For differential vanishing, specialize Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_compl_support, the realization of [lem-sc-etale-at-prime-formally-etale-cotangent-criterion], at q and take its differential-support component.

source.place: Tags 00U6 and 08WD; localization of differentials and flatness

proof.text: For (3) implies (2), first use [lem-weil-pbc-flat-over-localization] to turn flatness of S_q over R_p into flatness over R. The canonical IsLocalizedModule.iso identifies S_q with LocalizedModule q.primeCompl S. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-openness-of-flatness] to M=S. Vanishing of localized differentials puts q in the unramified locus by Mathlib Algebra.unramifiedLocus_eq_compl_support. This locus is open because S is of finite presentation, hence essentially of finite type. Choose D(g) containing q inside the intersection of these two open loci.

source.place: Tags 00U6 and 08WD; localization of differentials and flatness

proof.text: For every maximal ideal P of S_g, let p be its contraction to S. The element g is outside p since its image in S_g is a unit. The flat-locus inclusion from the preceding step gives R-flatness of S_p. Mathlib IsLocalization.localizationLocalizationAtPrimeIsoLocalization identifies S_p with (S_g)_P; restrict scalars on this equivalence to R. The local flatness criterion [lem-pc-affine-sections-flat-over-base], realized by Module.flat_of_isLocalized_maximal, now gives flatness of S_g over R.

source.place: Tags 00U6 and 08WD; localization of differentials and flatness

proof.text: The same basic-open inclusion gives FormallyUnramified R S_g directly by Mathlib Algebra.basicOpen_subset_unramifiedLocus_iff. Principal localization preserves finite presentation. Mathlib Algebra.Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat (Tag 08WD) combines these two instances and flatness from the preceding step to give Algebra.Etale R S_g. This is the ring form of the flat, unramified, finitely presented criterion in [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Apply the reverse direction of the first step.
